title: VPC install readiness orchestrator: end-to-end preflight checks
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build an orchestrator that runs an ordered set of preflight validations for Private (VPC) installs. The goal is a single CLI/CI step (and API) that validates tenant quota, IAM permissions and role bindings, DNS and resolver settings, GPU instance availability and skus, and basic Terraform module compatibility before we kick off a full install or an upgrade. Outputs: machine-readable report, human-readable summary, per-check remediation hints, and automated remediation where safe (e.g., enable APIs, add DNS records via approved automation).
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator runs end-to-end in CI and completes within 10 minutes for typical accounts
Detects missing quotas (GPUs, vCPU, static IPs) and surfaces exact quota metric and current usage
Validates IAM roles and policies required by Redwood Private installer; produces a minimal fix script for each missing permission
Checks DNS resolution for control-plane endpoints from customer VPC (private zones and forwarding) and flags misconfigurations
Verifies GPU capacity by querying cloud provider availability APIs and cross-checking against requested SKUs; recommends fallback SKUs
Produces JSON report schema v1.0 and summary log with exit codes for CI gating
Automated remediation gated behind opt-in flag and audit log; no destructive changes by default
steps: Define canonical check list and JSON schema for results
Implement provider adapters: GCP, AWS, Azure (quota APIs, IAM introspection, DNS APIs, GPU availability)
Wire orchestration layer to run checks in parallel where safe and sequential where dependencies exist (e.g., DNS before control-plane connect)
Integrate with existing Terraform modules to validate module outputs and required provider versions
Add optional safe remediation primitives (enable API, request quota via ticket template, create DNS record using approved automation)
Add CI step, smoke test harness and a lightweight web UI for engineers to inspect the report
